body_motion:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original low-resolution game sprite animation source sheet, transparent background.
Reference image is the APPROVED Kicker character design. Preserve exactly his warm brown skin, black quiff, coral headband, cobalt blue short jacket with lime collar and lightning-shaped lime chest panels, white undershirt, navy cropped cargo pants, black gloves, broad ivory foot wraps with bare toes and jade spray can at hip. Same athletic body, size and lighting in every cell. No weapon.
Create SIXTEEN whole-body animation drawings arranged in a strict FOUR column by FOUR row grid. Every cell has equal canvas dimensions with generous transparent margins. One complete connected character per cell; never split torso and legs. All face screen-right in the same 3/4 side view as approved reference. Do not print text, labels or gridlines.
Row 1: four subtly different idle drawings forming a breathing cycle: neutral approved upright pose; inhale; relaxed shoulders; settle. Feet planted, head and proportions consistent.
Row 2 and Row 3: eight consecutive grounded jogging gait frames for ONE fluid cycle. From right-foot forward contact, compress, right-leg passing, rise, left-foot forward contact, compress, left-leg passing, rise. Distinct leg positions, restrained body bounce, arms counter-swing, headband and jacket follow. Feet alternate visibly. Athletic jogging, not a sprint. A foot always near the common ground baseline, no flying.
Row 4: four consecutive basic snap-kick drawings: compact guarded anticipation, chambered knee, fully extended wrapped foot facing right, returning to guard. Maintain the same character, not a new body.
Visual style: simple blocky pixel-game sprite art, crisp solid colours, very limited flat shading. This is an animation production sheet, not a polished character poster. Approximately 44 logical pixels standing height; keep readable large colour blocks at that scale. No tiny texture, smooth gradients, ground shadows, detached limbs, action trails, effects or scenery. Keep the sprite size identical across idle and walking; kicks may extend sideways only. Genuinely transparent background.
body_actions:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: original game animation sprite sheet with real alpha transparency.
Use the reference as the locked APPROVED Kicker identity: warm brown skin, black quiff, coral headband, cobalt-blue short jacket with lime collar and lime panels, white shirt, navy cargo trousers, black fingerless gloves, huge ivory foot wraps and bare toes, jade spray can at hip. No other character. Identical flat lighting, human anatomy and proportions in every frame. Simple blocky sprites with restrained flat shading that remain readable at 44 logical pixels tall.
Create SIXTEEN distinct WHOLE-BODY drawings in a strict 4 column x 4 row equal-cell grid, all facing screen-right. Generous transparent margins, no labels/grid/ground/effects/shadows, no perspective enlargement or tiny detailed textures. Head and clothing do not change between actions.
Row 1: four jump and landing drawings: crouch/compress; launch with tucked knee and arms up; aerial forward kick/diving descent; landing low with a hand bracing ground.
Row 2: four rock-throw drawings: reach for pebble; draw throwing arm back; arm and body extend to release a small stone; follow-through. Both legs and feet stay present and connected.
Row 3: four special poses: stable low rooftop perch; higher crouched ready-to-leap perch; shoulder-recoil hit reaction; spray-can tag stance with one hand lowered to mark an anchor, upright body visible.
Row 4: four sequential defeat drawings: knees buckle; drop onto knees leaning to side; fall onto side with bent legs; fully lying on side, whole person visible. Do NOT shrink or shorten the body when prone, allow it to extend horizontally.
Preserve the reference face and outfit exactly. These are animation production drawings; transparent background, no scenery, no separate cropped upper/lower body parts.
